item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 29/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A band of clouds will cover the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Winds will be weak over the region on New Year's Eve and it will be warm during the day. A surge of northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China later on Sunday. It will be windy and slightly cooler over the region in the following couple of days. Under the influence of a replenishment of the monsoon, it will be persistently cool in the morning and at night over southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
